q_mercy_hemlock.title: The Mercy of Hemlock
q_mercy_hemlock.description: Sister Vanya needs Wolfsbane Nectar to mercifully end the suffering of her dying patients before the Dawnbound burns them alive.

1.description: Acquire Wolfsbane Nectar from Commander Malakor at the Iron Drake Bastion.

2.description: Deliver the Wolfsbane Nectar to Sister Vanya in the Ruined Chantry.

q_mercy_hemlock.completion_text: Sister Vanya administers the nectar with tears in her eyes. The patients pass peacefully in their sleep before the fire falls.

q_blood_brass.title: Blood and Brass
q_blood_brass.description: Commander Malakor seeks his fallen brother Loras's Iron Signet ring from the corpse pyres in Gallow-Square.

1.description: Search the charnel urns in the Gallow-Square for Loras's Iron Signet.

2.description: Return the signet to Commander Malakor at the Iron Drake Bastion.

q_blood_brass.completion_text: Malakor clasps his brother's signet against his forehead in solemn silence. His loyalty to you is sealed.

q_silk_cyanide.title: Silk and Cyanide
q_silk_cyanide.description: Madame Silve requires the Turnkey's Stolen Ledger held by Little Toby in the Gallow-Square.

1.description: Obtain the Turnkey's Stolen Ledger from Little Toby in the Gallow-Square.

2.description: Deliver the ledger to Madame Silve at the Gilded Rat Parlour.

q_silk_cyanide.completion_text: Madame Silve locks the incriminating magistrate records in her iron chest, rewarding you with forged passage.
